stages.name: Starts
stages.meaning: the game process starts under XCL; nothing on screen yet

stages.name: First pictures
stages.meaning: logos, intro video or a loading picture

stages.name: Title screen
stages.meaning: title screen, legal terms, account or profile prompt

stages.name: Menus
stages.meaning: the main menu or settings menus respond

stages.name: World loading
stages.meaning: the story or world starts loading after the menus; the world is not shown yet

stages.name: World on screen
stages.meaning: the game world itself is seen on screen (streets, buildings, trees, characters), even untextured or for a few seconds; not playable

stages.name: Playable
stages.meaning: someone controls the character for minutes (walking, driving) in a world they can see on screen, even with glitches, slowdowns or crashes

stages.name: Plays well
stages.meaning: a real session: an hour or more without a crash, a steady frame rate, missions that can be finished

branch_rule: branch: read by code from the report's text (amd-dev, nvidia-dev, integration/nvidia-world or '#2057 at <commit>', 'several'); null = main or not said
